Auto-answered by the orchestrator clarify-respond workflow.

DECISIONS:
Q1: A

RATIONALE:
Q1: The finding no longer reproduces on `main`. In `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py`, lines 544-546 set `config_override` for any `-c` / `--config-env` option. Lines 1557-1559 then turn every push with that flag into a confirmation prompt and `continue` before `_push_targets` runs. So `--repo=origin main` is never mistaken for a refspec, and the default-branch skip can't happen. Option A locks the exact exploit shape down with regression tests and leaves the documented "ask" behaviour alone. Option B would change confirmed behaviour that `agents.md` records ("Pushes with `git -c`, `--config-env`... ask too"), and option C would leave the exploit shape untested.

EXECUTION PLAN (required for any non-letter decision):
Q1:
  strategy: derive_from_repo (letter A; plan given so the planner has exact inputs)
  inputs:
    - tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py, `test_per_command_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs` (parametrize list at lines 1348-1356; test body at 1357-1365)
    - workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py lines 544-546 and 1557-1559 (read only, no change)
    - the `merged_branch_repo` fixture already used by that test (merged feature branch; origin is the repo's own remote)
  steps:
    - Add parametrize entries to `test_per_command_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs`, using the same non-secret placeholder URL as the other cases (`https://github.com/other/repo`):
      - `"git -c remote.main.url=https://github.com/other/repo -c push.default=current push --repo=origin main"` (the exact exploit shape)
      - `"git -c push.default=current push --repo=origin main"`
      - `"git -cremote.main.url=https://github.com/other/repo push --repo origin main"`
      - `"git --config-env=remote.main.url=REMOTE_URL push --repo=origin main"`
    - If the fixture's default branch is not `main`, replace the literal `main` with that branch so the default-branch path is actually exercised. Check the fixture setup first; it is still a single literal.
    - Keep the existing assertions: `permissionDecision == "ask"`, `query_pull_requests` is never called, and `other/repo` never appears in the output.
    - Do not change either hook copy, `agents.md`, or any other test. The byte-identity test for the live and template hooks is unaffected.
    - In the PR body, link the issue as a sub-issue fix and say the finding was verified fixed on `main` by PR #6286's guard changes. Link the tracker #3576 only with `Refs`.
  replaces_acceptance_criterion: "Resolve the positional remote and effective push refspec using the command's inline Git configuration; automatically deny the push if that mapping cannot be determined"
  equivalence_argument: The guard never trusts origin's PR history for any push that carries per-command configuration. It always asks, so the user confirms every such push and the merged-PR check can't be silently skipped. The new tests pin that exact invariant for the exploit command.
  reversibility: Tests only. If a human later wants a hard deny (option B), only the asserted `permissionDecision` value in these cases changes.
